bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money to Asian Economic Development Association for outdoor programs for youth.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; AEDA YOUTH SPORTS PROGRAMS. +]

[+$250,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the Board of Directors of the Minnesota Humanities Center for a grant to the Asian Economic Development Association (AEDA) for outdoor programs for youth. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money to Asian Economic Development Association for outdoor programs for youth.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; AEDA YOUTH SPORTS PROGRAMS.

$250,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the Board of Directors of the Minnesota Humanities Center for a grant to the Asian Economic Development Association (AEDA) for outdoor programs for youth.
additions: $250,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the Board of Directors of the Minnesota Humanities Center for a grant to the Asian Economic Development Association (AEDA) for outdoor programs for youth.
